lines.zh: 我一伸一缩地爬过叶面。
lines.en: I stretch and bunch my way across the leaf.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I follow the vein with a light tread.
I creep slowly to the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉长，再收回来。
lines.en: I draw my body long and pull it back.
I roll up from beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 我绕过叶上的一道裂口。
lines.en: I go round a split in the leaf.
I crawl toward the newer leaves.
I round a bend among the twigs.
I inch forward, step by step.
I stop to look ahead first.
I inch another half leaf forward.
I turn from the leaf tip and go down.
I cross between two touching leaves.
I work my way to the leaf stalk.
I avoid the drops on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我爬到有阳光的那一面。
lines.en: I crawl to the sunlit face.

lines.zh: 我伏在叶上，身体轻轻起伏。
lines.en: I lie on the leaf and my body stirs faintly.
I raise my front half and sway.
I hold the leaf in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一段叶梗。
lines.en: I hold still and look like a stalk.

lines.zh: 我听见上面有翅膀的声音。
lines.en: I hear wings above me.
I rest my head on the vein.

lines.zh: 风把叶吹得晃，我跟着晃。
lines.en: The wind sways the leaf and me.
I chew slowly, very quietly.
My segments swell one by one.
This leaf is fine; I do not want to move.
I tuck my front half into a fold of the leaf.
I wait for it to cool.
I arch forward and sway at you.
You are far bigger than the leaf.
I stretch out to test you.

lines.zh: 我没有真的眼睛，只凭感觉。
lines.en: I have no true eyes, only feeling.
When you move, the leaf trembles.
I draw back toward the leaf's center.
I stop my jaws and face you.
I reach out a little and pull back.
Your hands smell of leaves.
I flatten down and dare not move.
I curl up and keep twisting.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从叶上推下去。
lines.en: That knocks me off the leaf.
I can no longer hold the leaf.
I bow my body into an arc.
The pain makes me spit green fluid.
I shrink beside the vein and hide.
Half my body has gone stiff.
I am still on the leaf.
I keep that in my last segment.
I crawl slower and slower.

lines.zh: 嫩叶味道一飘来，我就爬过去。
lines.en: The smell of young leaf comes and I crawl over.

lines.zh: 你放下的那片，我立刻咬住。
lines.en: The leaf you set down, I bite at once.
This is tenderer than what is on the leaf.
I eat fast and flustered.
I stretch my body long to reach.
You hold it at the edge and I crawl there.
I chew to the vein before stopping.
One sway from you rocks all of me.
This mouthful will keep me busy.
I lift my head and wait for more.
The knock rolls me over.
I grip the leaf and do not fall.
I curl up and wait for you to go.
One finger knocks me off line.
I slip to the edge and crawl back.
The touch makes me arch.
I grip very hard.
I startle but am not hurt.

lines.zh: 我挪回叶脉最厚的地方。
lines.en: I work back to the thickest part of the vein.
Do not touch me.

lines.zh: 我们在一片叶上凑成一堆。
lines.en: We crowd together on one leaf.
It stops beside me.
Our bodies press together.
I creep half an arc around it.
It moves and the leaf quivers.
Our antennae touch.
We gnaw one leaf side by side.
It crawls off and I follow.
We are in no hurry.
Afterward we part ways.
I grip the leaf edge and tear a piece off.
I bury my head in the leaf flesh.
This bite is too old to break.
I gnaw a notch inch by inch.
I take the whole piece into my mouth.
I chew a long while.
This does not suit my taste.
One bite splits the leaf.
Green froth lines my mouth.
I will not let go and carry it along.
The leaf jolts and my head lifts.
Something is near; I stop.
I arch my front section up.
I stretch toward it.

lines.zh: 除了这片叶，我无处可去。
lines.en: Apart from this leaf I have nowhere.
I draw every segment tight.
That warmth is something alive.
I lie still to see how it moves.
It is right at the leaf edge.
I turn my head to it.
I stay aimed at its side.
It works the leaf rim and I follow.
I flatten myself to a sheet.
I creep slowly to the underside.
I hang where I am and dare not move.
It moves and the leaf swings.
I wait for it to leave.
I pull my head in.
I cannot run fast.
It still has not gone.
I open my mouth and bite.
I rear my front up and butt it.
My mouthparts are very hard.
I clamp down, my tail still thrashing.
That bite slid off.
I lash my front half.
The second bite goes deeper.
It withdraws and I stay on the leaf.
A sour taste stays in my mouth.
I slowly withdraw to the leaf's center.
I hatched on the leaf.
First I look for something to eat.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里钻出来，叶就在嘴边。
lines.en: I hatch with the leaf already at my mouth.
I crawl a small circle.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就是一层层的绿。
lines.en: I wake to green in every direction.
The wind tips the leaf.
I take my first bite ever.
The light here is very soft.
I tuck into the leaf seam.

lines.zh: 我不知道会长成什么样。
lines.en: I do not know what I will grow into.

lines.zh: 火把叶子烤卷，我拼命躲。
lines.en: Fire curls the leaf and I scramble away.
I hit the soil and roll over and over.

lines.zh: 一滴水把我淹住，我乱扭。
lines.en: A drop swallows me and I thrash.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶和我一起掀飞。
lines.en: The blast throws the leaf and me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我身体，我僵住。
lines.en: Something pierces me and I go stiff.
Cold settles on me and I cannot move.
Too long without leaf and I go soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整条缩紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I clench.

lines.zh: 我离开叶子，一路掉下去。
lines.en: I lose the leaf and fall away.
